```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

df <- fread(here::here("data", "MSI2_two_junctions_with_header.tsv"))
colnames(df)[1:2] <- c("junction", "gene")

df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(junction, gene),
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = junction,
    values_from = count
  )

meta <- fread(here::here("data","GTEx_Analysis_v11_Annotations_SampleAttributesDS.txt"))

j_short <- "chr17:57652162-57674917:+"
j_long  <- "chr17:57652162-57674971:+"

df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(junction, gene),
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = junction,
    values_from = count
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total = .data[[j_short]] + .data[[j_long]],
    frac_short = .data[[j_short]] / total,
    frac_long  = .data[[j_long]] / total
  ) %>%
  filter(total > 0) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = c("sample" = "SAMPID"))

ggplot(df_long %>% filter(total >= 10), aes(x = SMTS, y = frac_short)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal() +
 theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(y = "Fraction 324 Splice Junction vs 328 Splice Junction")
```

```{r}
#the previous just had the 2 junctions I was interested in, but there are actually 4 junctions that GTEx has. I want to make sure those other 2 junctions are skewing the results. 

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)


df <- fread(here::here("data", "MSI2_donor_all_junctions.tsv"))
colnames(df)[1:2] <- c("junction", "gene")

long_j  <- "chr17:57652162-57674971:+"
short_j <- "chr17:57652162-57674917:+"

# move to long format
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(junction, gene),
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    junction_class = case_when(
      junction == long_j  ~ "long",
      junction == short_j ~ "short",
      TRUE                ~ "other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample, junction_class) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = junction_class,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = 0
  )

df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(
    total = short + long + other,
    psi_short = short / total,
    psi_long  = long / total,
    frac_short_2iso = short / (short + long),
    frac_long_2iso  = long / (short + long)
  )

df_filt <- df_long %>%
  filter(total >= 10)


df_filt <- df_filt %>%
  left_join(meta, by = c("sample" = "SAMPID"))

ggplot(df_filt, aes(x = SMTS, y = psi_short)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Tissue",
    y = "PSI-like fraction",
    title = "MSI2 324 splice acceptor usage across GTEx tissues"
  )

ggplot(df_filt, aes(x = SMTS, y = psi_long)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Tissue",
    y = "PSI-like fraction",
    title = "MSI2 328 splice acceptor usage across GTEx tissues"
  )

ggplot(df_filt, aes(x = SMTS, y = other / total)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Tissue",
    y = "Other acceptors / total",
    title = "Competing MSI2 donor-sharing splice acceptors across GTEx tissues"
  )


stack_ex11 <- df_filt %>%
  mutate(other_frac = other / total) %>%
  group_by(SMTS) %>%
  summarise(
    ENST00000284073 = median(psi_long, na.rm = TRUE),
    ENST00000416426 = median(psi_short, na.rm = TRUE),
    other = median(other_frac, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -SMTS,
    names_to = "isoform",
    values_to = "fraction"
  )

stack_ex11$isoform <- factor(
  stack_ex11$isoform,
  levels = c("other", "ENST00000284073", "ENST00000416426")
)

cols <- c(
  "ENST00000284073" = "#4C78A8",  # muted blue
  "ENST00000416426" = "#F58518",  # soft orange
  "other" = "grey70"
)


order_levels <- stack_ex11 %>%
  filter(isoform == "ENST00000416426") %>%
  arrange(desc(fraction)) %>%
  pull(SMTS)

stack_ex11$SMTS <- factor(stack_ex11$SMTS, levels = order_levels)

ggplot(stack_ex11, aes(x = SMTS, y = fraction, fill = isoform)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Tissue",
    y = "Median fraction of exon 11 donor usage",
    title = "MSI2 exon 11 donor splice choices across GTEx tissues"
  )

ggsave(here("figures", "fig6D_GTExSplice.pdf"))
```

```{r}
#TCGA
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

read_spliceseq_file <- function(path, gene = "MSI2") {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  lines <- gsub("^<<|>>$", "", lines)

  spl <- strsplit(lines, "\t", fixed = TRUE)

  # first row is header
  header <- spl[[1]]

  # columns 1:10 are event metadata
  # sample IDs start at 11 and go until the last 2 columns
  sample_ids <- header[11:(length(header) - 2)]

  clinical_names <- c(
    "Gender", "Age", "Height_cm", "Weight_kg", "Tumor_Status",
    "Vital_Status", "Pathologic_Tumor_Stage", "Pathologic_N", "Pathologic_T",
    "Absolute_Purity_Value", "Tissue_Specific_Attribute_1",
    "Tissue_Specific_Attribute_2", "Tissue_Specific_Attribute_3"
  )

  # cohort name from filename
  cohort <- basename(path) |>
    str_remove("^PSI_download_") |>
    str_remove("\\.txt$") |>
    str_remove("\\(1\\)$")

  # find clinical rows
  clinical_idx <- which(vapply(
    spl,
    function(x) length(x) > 0 && x[1] %in% clinical_names,
    logical(1)
  ))

  # find event rows for gene
  event_idx <- which(vapply(
    spl,
    function(x) length(x) > 2 && x[1] == gene,
    logical(1)
  ))

  if (length(event_idx) == 0) {
    warning("No rows found for ", gene, " in ", basename(path))
    return(NULL)
  }

  # clinical block
  clinical_wide <- lapply(clinical_idx, function(i) {
    x <- spl[[i]]
    tibble(
      variable = x[1],
      sample = sample_ids,
      value = x[11:(10 + length(sample_ids))]
    )
  }) |>
    bind_rows() |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value) |>
    mutate(
      across(where(is.character), ~na_if(., "null")),
      Age = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Age)),
      Height_cm = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Height_cm)),
      Weight_kg = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Weight_kg)),
      Absolute_Purity_Value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Absolute_Purity_Value))
    )

  # event block
  event_tbl <- lapply(event_idx, function(i) {
    x <- spl[[i]]

    psi_vals <- x[11:(10 + length(sample_ids))]
    psi_vals[psi_vals %in% c("null", "", "NA")] <- NA

    tibble(
      cohort = cohort,
      sample = sample_ids,
      symbol = x[1],
      as_id = x[2],
      splice_type = x[3],
      exons = x[4],
      from_exon = x[5],
      to_exon = x[6],
      novel_splice = x[7],
      pct_with_values = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x[8])),
      psi_range = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x[9])),
      std_psi = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x[10])),
      PSI = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(psi_vals)),
      avg_exp_pct = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x[length(x) - 1])),
      annotation = x[length(x)]
    )
  }) |>
    bind_rows()

  event_tbl |>
    left_join(clinical_wide, by = "sample")
}

here::here()
spliceseq_dir <- here::here("data", "TCGA")

files <-list.files(
  path = here::here(),
  pattern = "^PSI_download_.*\\.txt$",
  recursive = TRUE,

files

#tidy columns

    Pathologic_T = na_if(Pathologic_T, "null"),

ggplot(tcga_all, aes(x = cohort, y = PSI)) +

    x = "TCGA cohort",

  )

cohort_order <- tcga_all |>

    y = "MSI2 PSI",
    title = "MSI2 splice usage across TCGA cohorts"
  )

ggsave(here("figures", "fig6E_TCGAsplice.pdf"))


#for later. 
plot_tcga_clinical <- function(df, cohort_name, xvar) {
  df |>
    filter(cohort == cohort_name, !is.na(.data[[xvar]]), !is.na(PSI)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = PSI)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = xvar,
      y = "MSI2 PSI",
      title = paste("MSI2 PSI in", cohort_name, "by", xvar)
    )
}
```

```{r}
#stats
library(dplyr)

run_stats <- function(df) {
  
  df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(PSI))
  
  # helper to check valid groups
  get_valid_groups <- function(data, var) {
    data %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[var]])) %>%
      pull(.data[[var]]) %>%
      unique()
  }
  
  # Tumor Status
  tumor_p <- tryCatch({
    sub <- df %>% filter(!is.na(Tumor_Status))
    if (length(unique(sub$Tumor_Status)) == 2) {
      wilcox.test(PSI ~ Tumor_Status, data = sub)$p.value
    } else NA
  }, error = function(e) NA)
  
  # Vital Status
  vital_p <- tryCatch({
    sub <- df %>% filter(!is.na(Vital_Status))
    if (length(unique(sub$Vital_Status)) == 2) {
      wilcox.test(PSI ~ Vital_Status, data = sub)$p.value
    } else NA
  }, error = function(e) NA)
  
  # Stage
  stage_p <- tryCatch({
    sub <- df %>% filter(!is.na(Pathologic_Tumor_Stage))
    if (length(unique(sub$Pathologic_Tumor_Stage)) > 1) {
      kruskal.test(PSI ~ Pathologic_Tumor_Stage, data = sub)$p.value
    } else NA
  }, error = function(e) NA)
  
  tibble(
    tumor_status_p = tumor_p,
    vital_status_p = vital_p,
    stage_p = stage_p
  )
}

tcga_all <- tcga_all %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~trimws(.))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~na_if(., "null"))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~na_if(., "~~~~~~~~"))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~na_if(., "")))

stats_df <- tcga_all %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  group_modify(~run_stats(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()

#multiple test correction
stats_df <- stats_df %>%
  mutate(
    tumor_status_fdr = p.adjust(tumor_status_p, method = "BH"),
    vital_status_fdr = p.adjust(vital_status_p, method = "BH"),
    stage_fdr = p.adjust(stage_p, method = "BH")
  )


run_stats <- function(df) {
  
  df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(PSI))
  
  tumor_sub <- df %>% filter(!is.na(Tumor_Status))
  vital_sub <- df %>% filter(!is.na(Vital_Status))
  stage_sub <- df %>% filter(!is.na(Pathologic_Tumor_Stage))
  
  tumor_p <- tryCatch({
    if (length(unique(tumor_sub$Tumor_Status)) == 2) {
      wilcox.test(PSI ~ Tumor_Status, data = tumor_sub)$p.value
    } else NA_real_
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  
  vital_p <- tryCatch({
    if (length(unique(vital_sub$Vital_Status)) == 2) {
      wilcox.test(PSI ~ Vital_Status, data = vital_sub)$p.value
    } else NA_real_
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  
  stage_p <- tryCatch({
    if (length(unique(stage_sub$Pathologic_Tumor_Stage)) > 1) {
      kruskal.test(PSI ~ Pathologic_Tumor_Stage, data = stage_sub)$p.value
    } else NA_real_
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  
  tibble(
    tumor_status_p = tumor_p,
    vital_status_p = vital_p,
    stage_p = stage_p,
    n_tumor_status = nrow(tumor_sub),
    n_vital_status = nrow(vital_sub),
    n_stage = nrow(stage_sub)
  )
}
```
